title: TextLabel
summary: Displays text: health numbers, names, messages. Key properties: Text, TextScaled vs TextSize, RichText for inline formatting, TextWrapped, and font/color controls.

properties.name: Text
properties.description: The displayed string. Assign to update: label.Text = "Coins: " .. coins.

properties.name: TextSize
properties.description: Fixed pixel size (default 14). Mutually exclusive style with TextScaled.

properties.name: TextScaled
properties.description: Auto-fit text to the label's bounds — pair with TextBounds/size constraints.

properties.name: Font / FontFace
properties.description: Legacy enum font or modern FontFace (with weight).

explanation.whatItIs: The 'show words' GUI element. Non-interactive (use TextButton for clickable text).
explanation.whyItExists: Every HUD needs numbers and names; labels render them.
whenToUse: RichText for mixed formatting in one label
tips: TextScaled for resolution-independent titles; fixed TextSize for body text
Update labels by assigning .Text — no special API needed
commonMistakes: TextScaled text overflowing tiny frames — constrain size or use TextTruncate
Setting Text to a number directly — use tostring() (Luau auto-coerces, but explicit is clearer and safer with nil)
Updating a label in StarterGui instead of PlayerGui — see that gotcha

examples.title: Live coins counter
examples.code:
-- LocalScript inside the TextLabel
local label = script.Parent
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

local function update()
    local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
    local coins = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
    label.Text = if coins then `Coins: {coins.Value}` else "Coins: —"
end

update()
local stats = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats", 5)
local coins = stats and stats:WaitForChild("Coins", 5)
if coins then
    coins.Changed:Connect(update)
end
